answer_1.quote: We focus on counterfactual generation for textual data, which involves editing given text with minimal modifications to produce new text that increases the probability of a predefined target label …

answer_2.quote: We use Flip Rate (FR), Probability Change (ΔP), Token Distance (TD), Perplexity (PPL), and Diversity (Div) as metrics …

answer_3.quote: We use ChatGPT (gpt-3.5-turbo-0125) with a temperature of 0.2 to evaluate the above textual quality metrics on a scale from 1 to 5 … We investigate an open-source LLM, Mistral-7B as an evaluation proxy.

answer_4.quote: human‑generated counterfactuals from crowdsourcing … We use ChatGPT (gpt-3.5-turbo-0125) with a temperature of 0.2 to evaluate the above textual quality metrics on a scale from 1 to 5.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each generated text on a 1–5 scale for fluency, cohesiveness, and grammar.
